lines.en: I'm going to be moving out, so you are going to be in charge of paying the rent.
Right. And when does that do?
No, just the months you actually want to live here.
Now, look, I know I kind of sprung this whole me moving out on you thing, so why don't I just cover you for a while?
No, no, no way. Joey Tribbiani does not take charity. Anymore.
I don't know. Forget it. Okay? I mean, thanks, but I'm done taking money from you.
All right, I can take care of myself. Now, what's next? Come on.
This is how much we pay for electric?
So, we'll do the rest of the bills later, then?
